description: Unauthorized Stream Access via Unprotected MediaStore Container The MediaStore container policy allows any AWS principal to GetObject and DescribeObject. Attackers could potentially access the MediaStore endpoint directly, bypassing CloudFront and its security controls. An attacker discovers the MediaStore endpoint and directly downloads stream segments, bypassing geographic restrictions and authentication mechanisms implemented at the CloudFront level.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement Origin Access Identity (OAI) for CloudFront and restrict MediaStore access
recommendation: Implement request signing for MediaStore URLs

description: Insecure RTMP Ingestion Points The security group allows unrestricted RTMP access from any IP address, relying solely on stream key authentication. An attacker could attempt to brute force stream keys or exploit RTMP vulnerabilities to inject unauthorized content into the streaming platform.
references: recommendation: Implement IP-based restrictions for RTMP ingestion
recommendation: Enhance RTMP authentication and monitoring
